name: wp-theme-leadsun
description: LEADSUN Chile custom WordPress theme foundation

scripts.build: sass assets/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && mkdir -p assets/css/fonts assets/js/vendor && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* assets/css/fonts/ && cp node_modules/aos/dist/aos.js assets/js/vendor/aos.js
scripts.build:dev: sass assets/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=expanded --source-map && mkdir -p assets/css/fonts assets/js/vendor && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* assets/css/fonts/ && cp node_modules/aos/dist/aos.js assets/js/vendor/aos.js
